title: The planning exam hp_gate_v3: v2's checks plus traps caught and no needless entity split, pinned before its run
request: The owner chose a fresh exam (v3) to judge the day's planning fixes honestly.
spec: Held-out tables and people written by an independent session; v2's six checks by v2's code; check 7 the serving plan enforces at least half of planted traps; check 8 no entity split where the case says none is needed; everything that decides the result pinned; run once.
plan: an independent session writes the material
v3 gate and commands from v2's
pin, commit, run tables and people once, judge

decisions.decision: Check 7 bar at 0.5 of planted traps for the serving plan
decisions.why: v2 never gated how much was caught; v2 rules caught 0.29, the practice set after the fixes 0.58 (read by the fixer)

decisions.decision: Entity traps planted only where the brief asks for new entities
decisions.why: for the same customers again a time split with the customer on both sides is honest; v2 may have counted those as misses

decisions.decision: Held-out people runs written as evaluation only (consent.json all off, evaluation_only in the result)
decisions.why: they were kept as dev material since v2; the full records stay, no training set reads them

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/planning_gate_v3/ (gate, run, commands, pin), dclab_rnd/agent_eval/harness_ablation/__init__.py (held-out runs evaluation only), tests/test_planning_gate_v3.py.

findings.defect: The pin did not cover v3's own checks and commands.
findings.scenario: rows.json is readable before judge; an edit to caught() would still pass pinned().
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: gate.py, __init__.py, tasks/enforced.py, e2e/score.py and harness_ablation/gate.py hashed into TERMS

findings.defect: The people run could be played twice and the better one picked.
findings.scenario: two harness_ablation runs on plan_held_v3, judge --people the better id.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: exactly one run on the set, on the pinned people, after the pin

findings.defect: Held-out people runs were kept as dev material.
findings.scenario: harness_ablation never sealed held-out sets; result split dev.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: consent.json all off in the run folder and evaluation_only in the result for HELD_OUT sets; registration required before pin and run

findings.defect: Check 8 could pass with nothing tested.
findings.scenario: no_group_needed as a list or a misspelled key: 0 everywhere, met.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: not judged unless a case applies; preflight needs a real column

findings.defect: The run-once guard lived in an ignored folder.
findings.scenario: run folder moved by the snapshot routine: a second run allowed.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: a committed start marker and the exam vault also refuse

findings.defect: The run did not record the code that measured it.
findings.scenario: an edit to enforced.obeyed between pin and run left no trace.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: code_state in the start marker and rows.json

findings.defect: A reader error lost a paid row and stopped the run.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs
findings.fix: reader in try/except, reader_error kept on the row

findings.scenario: needless_group=1, stopped rows in check 7, stale pin_problem, v2 people, marker refusal.
findings.cause: copied from v2 without its new needs

outcome: hp_gate_v3 is pinned before its run, with its own code, the counting code and the held-out material in the pin.
lessons: Pin every file that decides a verdict, the gate's own included.
A held-out run must be playable once and only once, by a guard that survives moving its folder.
risks: Check 7's bar of 0.5 was chosen after seeing v2 and the practice set.
